text:
Maria Gomez: quick question — we're seeing a bunch of user payloads with mixed dims + sparse placeholders. thinking about adding a lightweight cost overlay in Console to show estimated units before you send
Josh Lee: love that. is this just UI or do we need a header to carry estimates from clients?
Maria Gomez: both. UX: show per-route estimate and a "Try sample split" button. API: propose optional header `X-Embed-Estimate` so SDKs can fast-path and console can surface it
Ravi Patel: concrete ask: how do we compute the estimate? bytes vs dims vs sparsity? we need a deterministic formula that matches billing
Olivia Chen: suggestion: base by non-empty vector dims * unit_per_dim + payload_bytes * k. include a small multiplier for sparse flags. keeps close to current billing math
Josh Lee: worried about drift. runtime makes different choices (split/prefetch) — header must be advisory only. server still validates and can override
Maria Gomez: agree, advisory header only. if server disagrees include `X-Embed-Estimate-Reason` in response for console telemetry
console-bot: new idea: Console overlay shows two numbers "Client estimate / Server estimate" and a hint if they differ >15% :warning:
Ravi Patel: implementation sketch:
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json
X-Embed-Dim-Hint: 1536
X-Embed-Estimate: units=23;method=client-v1
{
  "inputs": [[...], [...]]
}
```
Josh Lee: SDK change: add computeEstimate(inputs) helper. For JS + Python. Console will call that client-side for preview. server returns `X-Embed-Server-Estimate: units=25;reason=split(2)`
Olivia Chen: telemetry: log client_estimate, server_estimate, final_units in per-request trace. add alert if common clients are consistently off by >30% (indicates mismatch in heuristics)
Maria Gomez: rollout plan: opt-in header for 2 weeks, then enable Console overlay for 5% of users, collect telemetry, iterate. Also add a lightweight docs snippet for SDKs
Ravi Patel: edge cases: extremely sparse vectors (mostly zeros), batched mixed-dims, and 413 split failures. we should still fall back to async-split and surface clear error messages in Console
Josh Lee: agreed. i'll draft the header spec and add a couple unit tests for parity with server estimator
Maria Gomez: awesome — tagging @Olivia to help map telemetry fields and @Ravi for runtime behavior. I'll put the spec PR up later today :thumbsup:
